# Spectrum Health & Human Services of WNY

> > Spectrum Health & Human Services provides integrated behavioral health, crisis intervention, and community support services across Western New York.

Spectrum Health serves the Buffalo and WNY region with comprehensive mental health care, suicide prevention programs through partnerships with AFSP and 988, addiction treatment, peer support services, and specialized training through SETI. The organization emphasizes whole-person integrated care combining behavioral and physical health services.

## Key Topics

- Mental health awareness and treatment
- Crisis intervention and 988 hotline
- Suicide prevention (AFSP, Suicide Prevention ECNY)
- Integrated behavioral health care
- Peer support services
- Addiction and substance use treatment
- Health equity and community support
- SETI (Spectrum Education & Training Institute)
- PTSD and trauma counseling
- Children and adolescent mental health
- Men's mental health
- Minority mental health
- HIV/AIDS awareness and education
- Self-care and coping strategies
- Western New York (WNY) community services

## About Spectrum Health

- [Our Team: Behavioral Health Professionals in WNY](https://shswny.org/our-team): Leadership team including Cindy Voelker, Nick Jerome & behavioral health staff
- [How Integrated Care Can Improve Your Life](https://shswny.org/how-integrated-care-can-improve-your-life): Whole-person integrated care approach combining behavioral & physical health

## Crisis Support & Suicide Prevention

- [PTSD Prevention: Get Trauma Help Before It Becomes PTSD](https://shswny.org/8779-2): PTSD prevention through immediate trauma counseling & crisis support
- [The "Whys"](https://shswny.org/the-whys): Explores athlete suicide & mental health ft. Grayson Murray, PGA Tour
- [Coping With the Aftermath: Crisis Support & Recovery Help](https://shswny.org/coping-with-the-aftermath): Crisis recovery support after traumatic events, including sports disappointment

## Mental Health Awareness & Education

- [Men and Depression: Two Brothers Share Their Story](https://shswny.org/men-and-depression-the-story-of-two-brothers-for-mens-mental-health-month): Brothers Paul & Dan share depression stories for Men's Mental Health Month
- [Olympic Athletes: Mental Health Behind Peak Performance](https://shswny.org/olympians-are-humans-too): Mental health pressures facing Olympic athletes beyond physical training
- [Children's Mental Health Awareness Week](https://shswny.org/happy-childrens-mental-health-awareness-week): Children's mental health awareness: emotional intelligence & development
- [Holiday Stress Management: Stop Shaking the Snow Globe](https://shswny.org/stop-shaking-the-snow-globe-you-can-get-thru-a-holiday-blizzard): Practical strategies for managing holiday stress and blizzard anxiety
- [December 1 is World AIDS Day](https://shswny.org/december-1-is-world-aids-day): World AIDS Day awareness: breaking stigma with facts from UNAIDS
